evidence.claim: Airace Technologies manufactures the FX6i, FX6i-Laser, and Navon GNSS RTK survey-grade positioning receivers, which feature NavIC capability, millimeter accuracy, and up to 1,408 channels.

Government e-Marketplace (GeM) listing records show that Airace Technologies supplies these high-precision RTK hardware units for public infrastructure schemes, village-level cadastral surveys (DILRMP), and urban digitization (NAKSHA).

Sensor Suite Breadth.assessed_on: We verified the availability of Airace's high-precision GNSS RTK positioning receivers. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed further details.

evidence.claim: Edith Defence Systems launched the indigenous IronCore F405 Flight Controller under its EDITHFPV brand, featuring integrated BMI270 gyro IMU and BMP280 barometer sensors.
The company developed a prototype of the "Black Panther" in-house quadruped robot dog for surveillance and combat missions utilizing domestically engineered actuators.

R&D and Innovation Capability.assessed_on: We verified in-house technology development and sensor integration through product launches. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed official patents, AI/ML target recognition algorithms, or institutional R&D partnerships.

evidence.claim: The company is officially classified as a DPIIT Recognized homeland security and defense tech startup, validating its compliance with foundational Indian governmental registration and administrative frameworks as shown on the Edith Defence Systems LinkedIn Profile.

In July 2026, the company launched an NDAA-compliant supply chain variant of its locally engineered IronCore F405 flight controller to explicitly cater to Indian defense and government drone electronics procurement demands under the Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative, as documented by Bots & Drones India.

Regulatory Compliance & Certification.assessed_on: We verified the company's foundational DPIIT recognition and their development of localized, defense-focused compliance options (NDAA supply chains). Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed any explicit DGCA type certifications, MoD approvals, or formal military audit completions for their integrated drone sensors, which places them in the partial/self-reported category.

evidence.claim: In July 2026, Edith Defence Systems officially launched the IronCore F405 flight controller under its EDITHFPV product line, expanding its catalog to include NDAA-compliant configurations intended for Indian drone builders and defense applications, as documented by Bots & Drones India.
